body.name: Diagonal residual margins
body.construction: For every \(x\in\mathcal X\) and \(w\in\mathcal V\), choose \(0\le d_{xdw}\le\min\{q^0_{xdw},q^1_{xdw}\}\) and set \(u_{xw}=q^0_{x0w}-d_{x0w}\), \(r_{xw}=q^1_{x0w}-d_{x0w}\), \(v_{xw}=q^1_{x1w}-d_{x1w}\), and \(s_{xw}=q^0_{x1w}-d_{x1w}\). Impose \(\sum_{w\in\mathcal V}u_{xw}=\sum_{w\in\mathcal V}v_{xw}=c_x\) and \(\sum_{w\in\mathcal V}r_{xw}=\sum_{w\in\mathcal V}s_{xw}=f_x\).
